description: An order at a price: a limit sell holds the token in rungs over the price and sells it as the price rises through them; a limit buy holds the quote under the price and buys as it falls. Placed now in one transaction, nothing is swapped, and it earns the pool's fee while it fills. One price is one rung, one step of the pool wide (0.01% in a LoomDesk 0.1% pool, 0.1% in a 0.5% pool, 2% in a 1% to 5% pool; other pools by their own spacing, which ladder_pools gives); priceTo makes it a range of up to 40 rungs. Prices are built on the pool's steps: when that moves them more than 1% the plan is refused with the built prices, until they are asked for or acceptBuilt is set. A part fill is not final: the rungs trade back if the price turns before the order is complete. closeOnceFilled (the default) has the keeper close it once the price has passed all the way through and pay what it holds as it is, from the owner's gas tank. Closing an order early takes nothing of a gain on the current LoomLadder. Returns the unsigned transactions.

acceptBuilt.description: Place it at the prices the pool can hold, however far they lie from the prices asked for

amount.description: Of the asset the order holds, as a decimal string: the token for a sell, the quote for a buy

closeOnceFilled.description: Default true: the plan's `then` says how to set the rule once the order is placed

payWithEth.description: A limit buy in a pool quoted in WETH: pay in plain ETH, wrapped inside the same transaction. Default: whenever the wallet holds less WETH than the amount.

pool.description: A pool from ladder_pools; the default pool when left out

price.description: The limit price: dollars a token, or the pool's quote asset a token with unit "quote". A sell's is over the price now, a buy's under it.

priceTo.description: Where the order is complete, further from the price than `price`. Left out: one rung, the narrowest the pool has.

rungs.description: A range only; 5 when left out

shape.description: A range only. spot: even; curve: more where the order starts; bidask: more where it is complete

name: plan_limit_order
title: Place a limit buy or a limit sell
